author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers and More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE. We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE. ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE.

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists
content: WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS. JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. Ability to match an established cartoon art style. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). Send your CV and Portfolio to: jobs@jumpanimation.com or gawad26@gmail.com. You can also message us directly through Facebook!

author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery
content: WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! How to apply: Follow us, drop a comment, Send us a DM with a link to your portfolio or fill out the application form in our bio! You can also mail us info@youngonion.in

author: factornotes
title: Looking for Illustrator for Stationery
content: At Factor Notes, we love turning creative ideas into visuals that inspire, connect and tell a story. We’re looking for a talented and detail-oriented Illustrator to join our team and create original artwork for our stationery collections and brand campaigns. What You’ll Do: Create original illustrations and artwork for our stationery, planners, product collections and brand campaigns. Develop creative concepts, patterns, characters and visual elements. Mail your resume and portfolio to: careers@factornotes.com
